claims.text: The restaurant specializes in Juk (porridge) and Bibimbap dishes.
The menu features seasonal and signature items such as Octopus Kimchi Juk and Beef Stew Bibimbap.
Customers frequently describe the food as delicious and fresh.
The venue is suitable for solo dining and offers a clean environment.
The restaurant is located in Nonhyeon-dong, Gangnam-gu, Seoul.
